stkh_req__coverage__uc_archive.content:
The user shall be able to archive the HTML report, the LCOV data, the
justification report and the JUnit results of a run as one CI artifact.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_archive.rationale: The module verification report cites the archived LCOV and justification report.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_archive.title: UC5 Archived evidence

stkh_req__coverage__uc_gate.content:
The user shall be able to fail a CI job when the gated coverage is below a
configured threshold, and shall be able to tell a failed gate from a run
that could not be evaluated.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_gate.rationale: The platform quality criteria (85 % QM, 100 % safety) are enforced automatically.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_gate.title: UC4 CI gate

stkh_req__coverage__uc_justifications.content:
The user shall be able to justify intentionally uncovered lines with a
reviewed argument, and obtain an effective coverage figure that counts
justified lines as covered while reporting the raw figure alongside.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_justifications.rationale: Intentionally uncovered code needs a written, reviewable argument instead of a lowered threshold.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_justifications.title: UC3 Reviewed justifications

stkh_req__coverage__uc_scope_completenes.content:
The user shall see every source file of the declared coverage scope in the
report, including files that no test links against, with exact 0 % line and
branch coverage for those.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_scope_completenes.rationale: A file no test executes must not disappear from the evidence; it must count with 0 %.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_scope_completenes.title: UC2 Untested code is visible

stkh_req__coverage__uc_summary.content:
The user shall obtain a markdown summary of the run, on the GitHub Actions
step summary or in a file, even when the gate fails.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_summary.rationale: Reviewers read the numbers on the workflow page without downloading artifacts.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_summary.title: UC6 Job summary

stkh_req__coverage__uc_unified_report.content:
The user shall obtain, from one ``bazel coverage`` run, one report with line
and branch coverage for the C++ and Rust units of the module.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_unified_report.rationale: Module verification reports need one C0/C1 figure per unit regardless of language.
stkh_req__coverage__uc_unified_report.title: UC1 One report for C++ and Rust

tool_req__coverage_artifacts.content:
With ``--archive-dir`` the tool shall assemble the HTML report, the LCOV data
as ``coverage_report.dat``, the justification report directory and the
``test.xml`` files of the selected ``bazel-testlogs`` subtree with their
paths preserved, also when the gate fails; a missing test-logs directory
shall be an error.
tool_req__coverage_artifacts.title: Artifacts tree

tool_req__coverage_eff_branch_only.content:
A justified line that is covered but has a branch direction no instantiation
covers shall count its truly uncovered directions once as justified branches
and shall not count as a justified line.
tool_req__coverage_eff_branch_only.title: Branch-only justifications

tool_req__coverage_eff_gcovr.content:
The post-processor shall detect gcovr ``--html-details`` reports and apply
the same justification logic to them, reading totals from the LCOV file when
given and from the summary rows of the index page otherwise.
tool_req__coverage_eff_gcovr.title: gcovr HTML reports are supported

tool_req__coverage_eff_html.content:
Justified lines shall be restyled in the HTML report with a ``J`` marker, the
justification id and reason as tooltip and a distinct colour, the index page
shall show the effective figures, and stale justifications shall be listed in
``summary.txt``.
tool_req__coverage_eff_html.title: Justified lines are visible in the HTML

tool_req__coverage_eff_metric.content:
Effective line coverage shall be ``(covered + justified) / total`` and
effective branch coverage ``(covered + justified branches) / total branches``,
with the totals taken from the report's own totals (llvm-cov index page, or
the LCOV for gcovr reports), both floored to two decimals, never rounded up.
Raw figures shall be reported alongside.
tool_req__coverage_eff_metric.title: Effective coverage metric

tool_req__coverage_eff_path_match.content:
A justification for a file shall apply to a report page only when the page's
source path equals the justified path or ends with it at a path-component
boundary; ``bar.cpp`` shall not apply to ``foobar.cpp``.
tool_req__coverage_eff_path_match.title: Justifications match files at path-component boundaries

tool_req__coverage_eff_stale.content:
A justified line that is covered in any instantiation and has no uncovered
branch shall be reported as stale and shall not increase the effective
coverage.
tool_req__coverage_eff_stale.title: Stale justifications are reported and not counted

tool_req__coverage_gate_exit_codes.content:
``generate_coverage_html`` shall exit 0 when the gate passes, 1 when it fails,
and 2 when no verdict is possible. A tool failure shall never end in exit 0.
tool_req__coverage_gate_exit_codes.title: Exit codes

tool_req__coverage_gate_metric.content:
With ``--yaml`` the gate shall use the effective line coverage from the
justification report; without it the raw line coverage summed over all
``LF``/``LH`` records of the LCOV data, so that baseline-only files count.
The llvm-cov text summary, which omits baseline files, shall not be used.
tool_req__coverage_gate_metric.title: Gated metric

tool_req__coverage_gate_no_verdict.content:
A missing or non-zip coverage report, a report without ``html_report/``, LCOV
data without instrumented lines, ``LH`` exceeding ``LF``, a missing
justification YAML, a failing justification tool, or a missing
``summary.txt`` shall end the run with exit 2.
tool_req__coverage_gate_no_verdict.title: Broken input yields no verdict

tool_req__coverage_gate_threshold.content:
The threshold shall be read from ``COVERAGE_THRESHOLD`` and default to 100 %.
A value that is not a number in ``[0, 100]`` shall be rejected before any
report is produced (exit 2).
tool_req__coverage_gate_threshold.title: Threshold from the environment

tool_req__coverage_gate_unrounded.content:
The gate shall compare the unrounded percentage with the threshold; a value
that prints as 100.00 but is below 100 shall fail a threshold of 100.
tool_req__coverage_gate_unrounded.title: Unrounded comparison

tool_req__coverage_just_markers.content:
The justification processor shall resolve ``COV_JUSTIFIED <id>`` to the
marker's line and ``COV_JUSTIFIED_START <id>`` / ``COV_JUSTIFIED_STOP`` to the
lines strictly between the markers, in checked-in sources with the
configured extensions, skipping Bazel output directories, and shall combine
them with the explicit ``locations`` of the YAML into a manifest keyed by
workspace-relative file and line.
tool_req__coverage_just_markers.title: In-code markers

tool_req__coverage_just_missing_file.content:
A YAML location whose file does not exist shall be reported as an error and
the processor shall exit 1 after writing the manifest.
tool_req__coverage_just_missing_file.title: Justified locations exist

tool_req__coverage_just_platform.content:
When a platform is given, only justifications listing that platform shall
apply.
tool_req__coverage_just_platform.title: Platform filter

tool_req__coverage_just_unknown_id.content:
A marker whose id is not in the (platform-filtered) YAML, a ``STOP`` without
``START`` and a ``START`` without ``STOP`` shall be reported as warnings and
shall justify no line.
tool_req__coverage_just_unknown_id.title: Unknown marker ids do not justify anything

tool_req__coverage_just_yaml.content:
The justification processor shall reject, with exit 1 and a message per
finding, a YAML that is not a mapping with an integer ``version`` and a
``justifications`` list, or that contains an entry without a kebab-case
string ``id``, a known ``category``, a non-empty list of known ``platforms``
or a non-blank ``reason``, or with malformed ``locations``. Duplicate ids
shall be rejected.
tool_req__coverage_just_yaml.title: Justification YAML is validated

tool_req__coverage_merge_no_data.content:
When a test has no instrumented objects or no ``profraw`` files, the merger
shall exit 0 without writing an output file and shall say so on stderr, so
non-instrumented tests (for example Python tests) do not fail the run.
tool_req__coverage_merge_no_data.title: A test without instrumentation produces no coverage output

tool_req__coverage_merge_profraw.content:
For each test, the merger shall merge all ``*.profraw`` files of the test into
one ``profdata`` file with ``llvm-profdata merge --sparse``, record the real
paths of the instrumented objects of the test in ``meta/meta.json``, and
package both into the test's coverage output. Object files come from the
``objects_list.txt`` entries of the coverage manifest (C++) or from ELF
binaries listed in the manifest (Rust); entries under ``external/`` are
skipped.
tool_req__coverage_merge_profraw.title: Per-test profiles are merged with llvm-profdata

tool_req__coverage_merge_tool_error.content:
When ``llvm-profdata`` cannot be located through ``LLVM_PROFDATA`` or
``RUST_LLVM_PROFDATA``, or exits non-zero, the merger shall exit 1 without
writing an output file.
tool_req__coverage_merge_tool_error.title: A missing or failing llvm-profdata fails the test's collection

tool_req__coverage_report_allowlist.content:
The reporter shall exclude every file with coverage data that is not in the
allowlist from all three report formats, matching each excluded compiled
file exactly (an excluded ``foo/bar.h`` shall not suppress an in-scope
``src/foo/bar.h``). An empty allowlist shall be an error (exit non-zero),
not an empty report.
tool_req__coverage_report_allowlist.title: The report is restricted to the scope allowlist

tool_req__coverage_report_baseline_zero.content:
For every allowlisted file that appears in the baseline objects but in no
test binary, the reporter shall run ``llvm-cov`` with ``--empty-profile`` over
the baseline objects and shall include the file in the HTML and LCOV output
with all instrumented lines and branches at zero hits, so that the LCOV
record shows ``LH:0``.
tool_req__coverage_report_baseline_zero.title: Untested in-scope files appear at exact 0 %

tool_req__coverage_report_merged_profile.content:
The reporter shall extract the ``profdata`` and object lists of all valid
per-test outputs, skip invalid or empty ones with a warning, merge the
profiles into one, and produce the HTML, LCOV and text reports from that
merged profile and the union of the instrumented objects.
tool_req__coverage_report_merged_profile.title: One merged profile for all tests

tool_req__coverage_report_missing_baseli.content:
When an entry of the baseline objects manifest cannot be resolved to an
existing file, the reporter shall exit non-zero instead of silently dropping
the object.
tool_req__coverage_report_missing_baseli.title: A missing baseline object is an error

tool_req__coverage_report_outputs.content:
The reporter's output shall be a zip containing ``html_report/`` (llvm-cov
HTML with branch counts), ``lcov_report/lcov.dat`` (LCOV with line and
branch records) and ``text_report/summary.txt`` (llvm-cov text summary), with
``llvm-cov`` warnings kept out of the LCOV data. When no valid per-test
output exists, the output shall be an empty zip.
tool_req__coverage_report_outputs.title: Report contents

tool_req__coverage_report_relative_paths.content:
The reporter shall name every file by its canonical path in all three
report formats: LCOV ``SF:`` records, the text summary, HTML page titles,
the HTML page location below ``coverage/`` and the index links. The
canonical path is the allowlist path; for a header compiled through a
``_virtual_includes/`` tree it is the declared header from the scope's
path map. No absolute directory of the producing machine, no
``/proc/self/cwd/`` prefix and no configuration-specific
``bazel-out/<config>/bin/`` prefix shall remain, so that the archived report
is portable and file identity depends neither on the machine nor on the
build configuration. The reporter shall read the sources it renders from
the scope's exported files, so that every index link points at a generated
page; a file compiled under several paths (a declared header covered by a
test binary and again by the baseline archive, or under two include paths)
shall appear once.
tool_req__coverage_report_relative_paths.title: Report paths are workspace-relative

tool_req__coverage_report_rlib_expansion.content:
``llvm-cov`` rejects an archive as a whole as soon as one member has no
``__llvm_covmap`` section: the ``lib.rmeta`` member of a Rust rlib, or the
object of a translation unit without code (the placeholder source of a
header-only library). Before passing baseline archives to ``llvm-cov``, the
reporter shall inspect every member's ELF section table and replace such
an archive by its members that carry a mapping, so that no library loses
its zero-coverage baseline because of one member. The object members of
the archives identify the sources that were compiled
(:need:`tool_req__coverage_report_unmapped`).
tool_req__coverage_report_rlib_expansion.title: Baseline archives are reduced to members with a coverage mapping

tool_req__coverage_report_unmapped.content:
An allowlisted file for which neither a test binary nor a baseline object
carries a coverage mapping (no translation unit includes it, or it holds
only template code that is never instantiated) cannot be rendered by
``llvm-cov``, not even at 0 %. The reporter shall write every such file to
``text_report/unmapped_files.txt`` (always present, empty when there are
none) as ``<category>\t<path>``, sorted, with one of three categories:
``declaration-only`` for a header whose same-named source file (same path
without extension) has coverage data, ``compiled-without-code`` for a
source whose object is a member of a baseline archive (it was compiled and
holds no code of its own), and ``no-data`` for everything else. The reporter shall emit a warning naming the ``no-data``
files; ``generate_coverage_html`` shall print them, copy the list into the
archive as ``unmapped_files.txt`` and show the ``no-data`` count in the job
summary table with one collapsible section per category. None of the
categories contributes to any total.
tool_req__coverage_report_unmapped.title: In-scope files without any coverage data are listed

tool_req__coverage_scope_baseline_object.content:
``score_coverage_scope`` shall list the static archives of in-workspace
``cc_library`` and ``rust_library`` targets and the coverage-built executable
of ``rust_binary`` targets in the objects file, so the reporter can produce
zero-coverage baselines for files no test links against.
tool_req__coverage_scope_baseline_object.title: Baseline objects accompany the scope

tool_req__coverage_scope_excludes.content:
``score_coverage_scope`` shall not list files of external targets and shall
not list generated files, with one exception: headers a workspace target
declares in its own ``hdrs`` from an external repository (see
:need:`tool_req__coverage_scope_transitive`). In particular, the public
headers a workspace target merely inherits by forwarding another target's
``CcInfo`` (a wrapper rule around a third-party library) shall not enter
the scope, and a ``_virtual_includes/`` path shall be mapped only when the
target itself generated it.
tool_req__coverage_scope_excludes.title: External and generated sources are excluded from the scope

tool_req__coverage_scope_transitive.content:
``score_coverage_scope`` shall collect, for the listed targets and their
transitive in-workspace dependencies reached through ``deps``,
``implementation_deps``, ``exported_deps``, ``components`` and
``implementation``, the checked-in source and header files of ``cc_library``
and ``rust_library`` targets (``srcs``, ``hdrs``) and the ``CrateInfo``
sources of ``rust_binary`` targets, and shall write them sorted and
deduplicated, one canonical path per line, to the allowlist file: the
workspace-relative path of a main-repository file, or
``external/<repo>/<path>`` for a header a workspace target declares from an
external repository. For a header a workspace target exposes through
``strip_include_prefix`` or ``include_prefix`` it shall additionally record,
in the path map, the generated ``<pkg>/_virtual_includes/<target>/...`` path
the coverage mapping names together with the declared header it stands for,
and it shall export the listed source files themselves (``source_files``
output group) so the reporter can read them independently of the workspace
directory.
tool_req__coverage_scope_transitive.title: Transitive in-workspace sources define the scope

tool_req__coverage_summary_first.content:
The markdown summary (``--summary-md``, or appended to ``GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY``
when the flag is absent) shall be written before the gate decides, so a
failing gate still leaves the summary; the explicit flag shall take
precedence over the environment variable.
tool_req__coverage_summary_first.title: Summary is written before the verdict

tool_req__coverage_validation_ground_tru.content:
The pipeline shall be validated end to end against a fixture workspace with
C++ and Rust units whose line and branch counts are derived by hand: the
produced LCOV shall match the expected records exactly (``DA``, ``BRDA``,
``LF``, ``LH``, ``BRF``, ``BRH`` per file), including exact-0 % records for an
untested C++ library and an untested Rust binary.
tool_req__coverage_validation_ground_tru.title: Ground-truth validation

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
